release_name: Coordinate refinement — 6 more moved onto the church
notes: Second coordinate pass. The first OSM query had silently dropped churches mapped only as building=church, so the reference set was incomplete; widening it (390 -> 446 features) surfaced six more churches whose coordinate pointed at the village rather than the building. All six now sit on the mapped church: Notre-Dame-de-l Assomption Roches-Noires (1552 m), Saint-Dominique Quatre-Cocos (1157 m), Notre-Dame-de-l Esperance Piton (950 m), Emmaus Coromandel (791 m), Saint-Louis Grand-Bois (646 m, mapped as grounds so recorded as exact_compound), Le-Seigneur-de-la-Peche-Miraculeuse La Gaulette (248 m). 10 rows changed, no schedule data touched. Churches shown with an exact location rise from 17 to 25 of 117. Three further candidates were rejected rather than applied: two were roads named Church Road and La Chapel Road, and Notre-Dame-de-Fatima Petite-Riviere-Noire was offered a feature tagged only landuse=religious with no religion or denomination, which is not evidence it is that church.
